title: Plastic Explosive
description: Crafted from 4 Gunpowder + Sticky Resin, can be placed (or thrown?) on blocks to explode; sort of replaces IC2 Dynamite

title: Tools storing a battery
description: Chainsaw, drills, etc, would store a battery inside with Bundle-like behavior in GUIs

title: Silicon Carbide
description: Made from Coal and Silicon dusts, come with set of tools or substitute Diamonds in some recipes; sort of replaces IC2 Industrial Diamond

title: Bedrock Drill, Ore Scanner
description: Outputs ores when placed on bedrock and supplied with energy and drilling bits, essentially converting energy to items, which has numerous consequences; sort of earlier cheaper Matter Generator

title: Resin Sapling trades
description: Trades similar to other sapling in Wandering Trader table; allows for some challenge runs
